empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: A skill is a reusable block of review instructions. Create one, or import a markdown file or archive.

select.title: Select a skill
select.body: Pick a skill on the left to preview and edit it, or add a new one. A skill becomes its own block in the prompt of every agent that has it selected.

card.turnOff: Turn this skill off — no agent will use it

form.name: Name
form.descriptionPlaceholder: Use on every PR that changes production code. Flag each new branch no test exercises.
form.descriptionHint: The description is the skill's interface: it tells the agent when the body applies. Write it as a directive — “Use when…”, “Flag…” — not as a summary.
form.bodyPlaceholder:
# Rule

Describe what to check and how to report it…
form.bodyHint: Text only — a skill has no tools and nothing in it is executed. Saving a changed body creates a new version.

create.title: Create skill
create.subtitle: A reusable block of review instructions you can link to any agent.

editor.loadErrorBody: The skill could not be loaded.

config.title: Configuration
config.messageHint: The note labels the new version in the history. Only a changed body creates a version; leave the note empty and one is written for you.
config.deleteHint: Deleting a skill unlinks it from every agent. This cannot be undone.
config.deleteConfirm: Delete skill “{name}”? It will be unlinked from every agent. This cannot be undone.

preview.lead: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.

import.title: Import a skill
import.subtitle: Upload a markdown file or a .zip archive that contains a SKILL.md
import.tooLarge: This file is larger than 500 KB.
import.trustTitle: Someone else's skill is someone else's instructions
import.trustBody: Once an agent uses it, this text goes into that agent's prompt as rules to follow. Read it before you confirm. No agent uses the skill until you select it on that agent's Skills tab.
import.skippedBody: A skill is text only. These files were never unpacked or run:
import.imported: Imported “{name}” — select it on an agent to use it

versions.title: Version history
versions.hint: Every change to the body is saved as a new version, and each run records which version of the skill it used. History is never rewritten — restoring an old version adds a new one on top — so any past run can be reproduced exactly.
versions.label: v{version}
versions.diffAria: Diff v{version} against the current version
versions.loadError: Could not load the version history.
versions.emptyBody: A version is recorded each time the skill body is saved.
versions.diffSubtitle: Red lines exist only in the old version; green lines only in the current one.
versions.diffIdentical: This version's body is identical to the current one.

stats.agentsEmpty: No agent has this skill selected right now.
stats.byCategoryEmpty: No findings in the last 30 days.
stats.attribution: Counted over completed runs from the last 30 days. A finding belongs to a run, not to a skill — a run that used several skills credits its findings to each of them, so these numbers show what the skill took part in, not what it caused alone.
stats.emptyBody: Link this skill to an agent and run a review. Pull frequency, accept rate and findings appear once a run that used the skill completes.
stats.emptyBodyLinked: No completed run has used this skill in the last 30 days. Pull frequency, accept rate and findings appear after the next one.
stats.loadError: Could not load stats for this skill.
